paper_id: Edge Intelligence_ The Confluence of Edge Computing and Artificial Intelligence
title: Edge Intelligence: The Confluence of Edge Computing and Artificial Intelligence
motivation: 物联网设备产生的数据量激增，若全部上传云端处理将造成严重网络拥塞，需在边缘执行AI模型
problem_framing: 将Edge Intelligence划分为AI for edge(用AI赋能边缘计算)和AI on edge(在边缘运行AI模型)两个方向
key_insight: QoE多目标联合优化需涵盖性能、成本、隐私、效率、可靠性，而非单一指标
method_signature: 自底向上拓扑-内容-服务分层 + 自顶向下模型适配-框架设计-处理器加速
evaluation_criteria: QoE综合指标:性能、成本、隐私、效率、可靠性；训练损失与推理精度
negative_result_or_admitted_limitation: Edge Intelligence目前处于早期阶段，许多概念仍不清楚，问题尚未解决
evidence_for_toggle: vanilla version of Federated Learning has strong demand for communication efficiency
Edge Intelligence, currently in its early stage, and is attracting more researchers
many concepts are still unclear and questions remain unsolved
this survey is not fully covered by this survey
Processor Acceleration is mainly investigated by AI researchers, this paper will not delve into it
thinking_moves: 从顶层QoE多维指标统一两个方向的研究目标
自底向上分解AI for edge问题层次，自顶向下分解AI on edge技术栈
将现有survey未能覆盖的空白作为写作动机
先建立概念分类框架，再填充具体研究方向
区分AI服务于边缘计算 vs AI模型本身部署在边缘这两条技术路径
